about: Notes on single lifts from sources other than OpenStreetMap (resort pages, local reports), shown on the lift's card (lifts.js). Match by the lift's OpenStreetMap way id (osm). Hand-edited: keep each note a plain fact with its source and the day it was checked; never promise access or safety. The English text and title need a French line in scripts/i18n/fr-N.txt.

notes.lift: Mountain Sightseeing Lift Alps No.11 Pair Lift
notes.title: Waiver to ride
notes.text: The resort asks riders to hand in a mountain-climbing registration form, or to agree to and sign its No.11 Pair Lift waiver, before riding this lift. Rules can change: check with the resort before you go.
notes.src: Hakuba Norikura Onsen Ski Resort's website and a local report
